step.action: Ask people using the tables to remove their belongings.
step.expectedResult: The tables are available for cleaning.

step.action: Place abandoned personal belongings in Kitchen Lost and Found.
Pick up MOOP from the tables, under the tables, and around the tables.
step.expectedResult: No MOOP remains on, under, or around the tables.

step.action: Put the collected MOOP in the correct Kitchen Waste Station container.
Brush crumbs and dry debris into the Kitchen Cleaning Kit dustpan.
step.expectedResult: No crumbs or dry debris remain on the tables.

step.action: Wipe each tabletop and edge with the approved cleaner.
step.expectedResult: No visible food, dirt, oil, or sticky residue remains.

step.action: Apply the approved sanitizer evenly to each tabletop.
Keep each tabletop wet for the sanitizer label's contact time.
Leave each tabletop untouched until it is dry.
step.expectedResult: The tables are dry and immediately usable.

step.action: Put all used cleaning liquid into the Gray-Water IBC.
step.expectedResult: No cleaning liquid or wastewater reaches the playa.

passWhen.criterion: No food, crumbs, dirt, oil, or sticky residue is visible.
No MOOP is visible on, under, or around the tables.
Every tabletop and edge is dry.
No cleaning liquid or wastewater reached the playa.
